summary.en: End-to-end incoming-document processing — sync, extract, file and browse

use.note: INDOX uploads go to the drive app's local engine (admin profile) into the auto-created indox/uploads folder. INDOX depends only on local engines for its own storage; remote engines (drive, mail) are separately proven to work.

connections.note: Per-SYNC, never per-install: INDOX runs on the local drive + local mail engines out of the box (see use[].drive note). This credential is needed only once a sync is created against a specific external account, so it must not be an install blocker. Google Drive/Sheets/Gmail sources only.

Optional accelerator, not a requirement: extraction reaches the same score on the local OCR engine (apitools declares this required:false for the same reason). Needed only when a repo is configured to extract with Gemini.

Per-SYNC, never per-install: INDOX runs on the local drive + local mail engines out of the box (see use[].drive note). This credential is needed only once a sync is created against a specific external account, so it must not be an install blocker. Gmail (IMAP) sources only; the local mailbox needs no credential.

sql.note: SHARED vs PER-INSTANCE: every table here is per-instance (one copy in each indox_<id> schema) EXCEPT those in shared_tables, which live once in public and are addressed by every instance. ai_extraction_cache is shared on purpose (owner, 2026-08-28): it is keyed by content hash, so the same supplier PDF arriving at two clients is OCR'd once rather than twice. It must never be schema-qualified — indoxApi01's Build Table Get / Build Table Upsert hold the SHARED map that enforces this. [2026-08-27] Five tables were live but UNDECLARED, so data-management scored them UNCLAIMED and they were in no export, backup or deployment transfer: incoming_documents_archive (15,366 rows, and registered as a repo the console can switch to), indox_action_execution_log (485k rows, the action-log source of truth), indox_priority_local (the ERP stand-in), and the two live aggregates indox_dashboard_stats / indox_sync_stats. settings_history is new in the same change. Nineteen further public.* tables carry the indox_/incoming_ prefix and are deliberately NOT listed: they are dated scratch from past migrations (see the stale list in the tenancy review) and declaring them would enshrine debris in every future backup.
